item.title: Ima Koko ni, Netorare Shoujo ga Tanjou Suru.
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sarobetsu Ginga
  • 発売日: 2020-06-15
  • スコア: 5.88/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 今ここに、寝取られ少女が誕生する。
  • 英語名: Ima Koko ni, Netorare Shoujo ga Tanjou Suru.

あらすじ

The school boy Happei had no confidence in himself.

At this rate, he was bound to become a job-less shut-in after graduation.

Worried about him, his childhood friend Mai transfers to his school, and tries to wake him up from his listless daze.

However, she does not get the reception she expected, and he remains unchanged.

There once was a boy student who liked the girl next door.

item.title: Kenage na Niizuma ga, Hoka no Otoko ni Kiss Houshi Shimasu.
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sarobetsu Ginga
  • 発売日: 2016-09-07
  • スコア: 7.06/10 (17 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 健気な新妻が、他の男にキス奉仕します。
  • 英語名: Kenage na Niizuma ga, Hoka no Otoko ni Kiss Houshi Shimasu.

あらすじ

Weeks into their marriage, Anna Yuzuki is already cheating on her husband.

It’s not her fault. After the honeymoon a man suddenly shows up.

He’s Natsuki, an old friend of her husband, come to collect a large debt.

Seems that Anna’s husband owes $100,000 dollars.
